title: Mossvale
description: A voxel vale to adventure in together. Players, creatures, loot and quests are entities in this app's store; where each player stands is relayed between them and kept by nobody.

player.description: Someone who walks the vale: the name over their head, and the colours they wear. Everything they have done is in rows of its own (slain, item, journal), so a visitor who is not signed in, who can only add rows, still keeps it.

pose.description: Where a player stands this moment and what they are doing, relayed to everyone in the vale and kept by nobody: it goes when their connection does. It carries their fight too, the damage they have dealt the creature they are fighting in its current life.

yaw.description: Which way they face, in radians.

swing.description: Counts their blows, so a page sees each one.

dmg.description: The damage they have dealt it in this life.

life.description: Which life of the creature: when it last fell, in ms.

body.description: A mover as this page simulates it, every frame: the player's own hero, and each creature near them. Never leaves the page.

hunts.description: The player a creature is after.

bite.description: When a creature last bit, in ms.

creature.description: A creature of the vale and the place it roams from. How hurt it is lives in the players' poses; each time it falls, a slain row says so.

roam.description: How far from home it wanders, in metres.

npc.description: Someone who lives in the vale and gives out its quests.

greets.description: What they say when there is nothing to ask of you.

quest.description: Something the Elder asks of a player. Its doc holds the title and the words; quests are offered in step order, each once the one before is done.

target.description: A creature kind to slay, or an item kind to gather.

gift.description: An item kind given on completion.

slain.description: A player's share in a creature's fall. The first row after the creature was last up is the fall itself; the others are the players who helped.

item.description: Something a player picked up or was given.

used.description: An item spent: a tonic drunk, jelly handed to the Elder.

journal.description: A step in a player's quest: taken, then done.

drop.description: Loot lying on the ground for this player alone, until they walk over it. Never leaves the page: picking it up writes an item.
